title: Cloud workflow schedules lack safe CLI lifecycle and verifiable provenance
description:
Source: https://github.com/AgentWorkforce/cloud/issues/2872

## Outcome

Make scheduled workflow deployments safely operable and verifiable from the Agent Relay CLI without duplicate schedules or hand-written HTTP calls. This is one cross-repository team task: Cloud owns API/storage correctness and Relay owns the CLI/SDK surface.

## Relay workstream

Add these commands:

- `relay cloud schedule update <id> <workflow> [--cron] [--timezone] [--name] [--description] [--env KEY=VALUE]`
- `relay cloud schedule pause <id>`
- `relay cloud schedule resume <id>`
- `relay cloud schedule delete <id> [--yes]`
- `relay cloud schedule show <id> [--json]`

Back them with Cloud SDK functions beside `scheduleWorkflow` and `listWorkflowSchedules`. Update must reuse `resolveWorkflowInput` and the same TypeScript/YAML validation gate as create. Delete prompts unless `--yes` or non-interactive. Creating a second active schedule with the same name must warn or require an explicit duplicate flag.

## Cloud workstream

Expose non-secret provenance from `toPublicWorkflowSchedule`: `workflowHash` (sha256), `workflowFileType`, `workflowBytes`, `envSecretKeys`, and optional source `{ gitSha, branch, path }` captured at create/update time.

Fix PATCH so updating workflow content without `envSecrets` preserves the schedule's existing environment secrets. Keep `parsePatchBody` and workflow request handling split as they are now.

## Acceptance

- Updating workflow content is one CLI command and creates no duplicate.
- `schedule show` reports a stable hash that changes after content changes.
- A workflow-only PATCH preserves existing environment secrets, with a regression test.
- Pause stops firing, resume restores it, and delete removes it from list output.
- Duplicate active names require an explicit choice.
- Invalid workflow updates fail before mutating the stored schedule.
- Both repositories open PRs with test evidence; Factory must not merge them.

Existing schedule source backfill is out of scope.
